name: Gorge Rouge
source:
Juni reluctantly enters a boarding school, expecting annoyance and boredom. Instead, she finds secrets – and they’re about her. Something mysterious happened before she got there.

Is she ready to face it?

[From [url=https://shark-sandwich.itch.io/gorge-rouge]Itch.io[/url]]
